description: Generate an invoice PDF from structured data (seller, buyer, line items, tax); no template needed. Deterministic: the same input produces byte-identical output. Without a paid PDFops key the output carries a small "Generated with pdfops.dev" footer line. Returns the invoice written to output_path, or inline as an application/pdf resource when output_path is omitted; an existing file at output_path is overwritten. An existing invoice PDF or a fillable template is populated with pdf_fill instead. Setting invoice.e_invoice to "factur-x" produces an e-invoice instead: a PDF/A-3 file with the invoice data embedded as factur-x.xml (UN/CEFACT Cross Industry Invoice, profile EN 16931, also called COMFORT). Several more fields then become required, and a missing one fails with einvoice_fields_required naming every missing field: invoice_number, date, currency (no default), due or payment_terms, from.country and to.country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes), from.vat_id (or from.tax_id with from.registration_id), tax_category when tax_rate is 0, and a UN/ECE Recommendation 20 unit code on every item. Amounts in the XML and on the page come from the same exact decimal arithmetic: each line is rounded to 2 decimals, VAT is computed once on the summed basis. On that path text is limited to Latin letters, Latin Extended-A, the euro sign and common punctuation (other characters fail with unrenderable_text); leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed, over-long or control-character text is refused with a 400, and long text wraps onto further lines or pages on the page and is carried in full in the XML. Per-item tax fields and other unknown fields are refused, and a buyer tax_id is refused (to.vat_id carries the buyer's VAT number). Checked in testing with the Mustang validator 2.26.0 (PDF/A-3 via veraPDF, XSD, EN 16931 schematron); this is not a statement of legal compliance, and XRechnung and Peppol output are not produced.

date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form (other formats are rejected with invalid_date). Shown on the invoice; also pins metadata for determinism

due.description: Shown as given. With e_invoice it must be a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

e_invoice.description: Produce a Factur-X (ZUGFeRD) EN 16931 e-invoice: PDF/A-3 with factur-x.xml embedded. Makes several fields required, see the tool description.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code in capitals (1A for Kosovo, as in the EN 16931 list). Required when e_invoice is set.

registration_id.description: Legal registration number, for example a commercial register number.

tax_id.description: National tax number. With e_invoice it is accepted for the seller only: EN 16931 has no buyer tax number, so to.tax_id is refused (to.vat_id carries the VAT number of the buyer).

vat_id.description: VAT identification number. With e_invoice it must start with a two-letter capital country prefix, such as DE123456789 (EL for Greece), and the seller needs vat_id, or tax_id plus registration_id.

iban.description: IBAN to pay into; the checksum is verified. Used only with e_invoice: written as SEPA credit transfer (code 58) for a EUR invoice and a SEPA-area IBAN, otherwise as credit transfer (code 30).

unit.description: UN/ECE Recommendation 20 unit code, for example C62 (one), HUR (hour), KGM (kilogram). Required when e_invoice is set.

payment_terms.description: Payment terms text. With e_invoice, either this or a due date is required.

tax_category.description: EN 16931 VAT category: S standard rate (the default when tax_rate is above 0), Z zero rate, E exempt, AE reverse charge, O not subject to VAT. Required with e_invoice when tax_rate is 0 or omitted. Ignored without e_invoice.

tax_exemption_reason.description: Reason text, required with e_invoice for tax_category E, AE and O.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code in capitals (1A for Kosovo, as in the EN 16931 list). Required when e_invoice is set.

registration_id.description: Legal registration number, for example a commercial register number.

tax_id.description: National tax number. With e_invoice it is accepted for the seller only: EN 16931 has no buyer tax number, so to.tax_id is refused (to.vat_id carries the VAT number of the buyer).

vat_id.description: VAT identification number. With e_invoice it must start with a two-letter capital country prefix, such as DE123456789 (EL for Greece), and the seller needs vat_id, or tax_id plus registration_id.

output_path.description: Path of a .pdf file to write the result to, inside the allowed directories (PDFOPS_ROOT, default the working directory); an existing file there is overwritten. Without it (as when running remotely) the PDF is returned inline as an application/pdf resource for the client to save.

name: pdf_invoice

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

output_path.description: Absolute path written, when output_path was supplied

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource, when output_path was omitted

title: Generate invoice PDF
